name: wasm-share
description: P2P file transfer via WebRTC + WebAssembly streaming

scripts.build:wasm: node -e "const wabt = require('wabt'); wabt().then(w => { const m = w.parseWat('compress.wat', require('fs').readFileSync('public/wasm/compress.wat','utf8')); const bin = m.toBinary({}); require('fs').writeFileSync('public/wasm/compress.wasm', bin.buffer); console.log('✓ compress.wasm generated'); })"
